learning_outcomes.description: Design entity-relationship (ER) models and map them to normalized relational schemas.
Formulate complex SQL queries including joins, nested subqueries, and window functions.
Explain transaction management, serializability, two-phase locking (2PL), and crash recovery (ARIES).

weeks.topic: Introduction to Data Models and Relational Databases.
Relational Algebra and Tuple Relational Calculus.
Basic SQL: Data Definition Language (DDL) and Queries (DML).
Advanced SQL: Grouping, Aggregations, and Correlated Subqueries.
Functional Dependencies and Normalization Theory (1NF, 2NF, 3NF, BCNF).
Storage Architecture and B+ Tree Indexing Structures.
Query Execution, Cost Estimation, and Relational Optimization.
Transactions, Concurrency Control, and Isolation Levels.
Database Recovery Mechanisms and Distributed Datastores.
